messages:
sophia: FYI: after the last postmortem, we've still had 2 recurrences of bad aggregation in the analytics pipeline. Opening a short sync to ensure ownership and next steps are clear. cc @maria @ashwin
maria: Thanks. What windows/metrics?
sophia: Dips observed at 02:45 and 10:45 UTC past 3 days. Using this check:```
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) as minute, count(*) as agg_rows
FROM analytics_aggregates
WHERE ts > now() - interval '72 hours'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
ashwin: Logs show a race between aggregator flush and ETL watermark advancement leading to dropped partial partitions. Found in aggregator logs:```
[2026-04-02T02:45:12Z] aggregator: warn: flush invoked while partition_locked=true shard=7
[2026-04-02T02:45:13Z] aggregator: error: commit failed: partial partition missing key range
```
kevin: Sounds like a coordination issue. We should add a lightweight lease to prevent concurrent flush+watermark shift. Can we own implementation?
sophia: Proposed owners: ashwin -> ETL watermark coordination fix + tests (48h), kevin -> infra lease/end-to-end testing + staging rollout (24h), maria -> postmortem update + customer impact (72h), observability-bot -> add recurrence monitor and page rule.
observability-bot: Recurrence monitor created: "agg-partition-flush-fail". Will page on second recurrence within 7 days.
maria: Also we need to fix the aggregation correctness test harness. I can take that and add a deterministic replay for partition/flush edge cases (due +7d).
ashwin: I'll add idempotent flush semantics and a guard that refuses flush if partition state is inconsistent, plus metrics for partial-partition-failures. Opening PR now.
kevin: I'll set up a canary on a single shard and run aggressive watermark shifts to validate. Scheduling test window.
sophia: product-analytics: do we need to inform customers? We'll quantify impact in the postmortem.
maria: Add to action list in tracker:
- ashwin: ETL + aggregator coord fix + tests (48h)
- kevin: infra lease + canary + staging validation (24h)
- maria: postmortem update + SLO impact calc (72h)
- sophia: recurrence watch + notify if >1 recurrence in 7d
Please react when you start items.
ashwin: :white_check_mark: starting work, PR WIP at https://git.internal/etl/pull/802
kevin: :white_check_mark: infra ticket INF-1350 filed, test window scheduled.
maria: :white_check_mark: starting postmortem draft. I'll attach timelines and affected dashboards.
sophia: We'll reconvene in 48h if mitigations not validated. Closing sync thread for now.
